items.headline: RBI keeps the repo rate unchanged
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee kept the policy repo rate unchanged. The repo rate is the rate at which the RBI lends to banks for short periods; changing it is the main tool of monetary policy. The committee has six members, three from the RBI.

items.headline: A bill to reform tribunals is introduced in the Lok Sabha
items.summary: A bill proposing changes to how tribunal members are appointed and how long they serve was introduced in the Lok Sabha. It now goes through the stages every bill follows before it can become law.

items.headline: Satellite pictures show sediment where the Ganga meets the sea
items.summary: Satellite images show plumes of sediment where the Ganga and Brahmaputra reach the Bay of Bengal. The sediment builds the delta, the largest in the world.
